SourceFile

# cue/format/testdata/comments.txtar / comment_alone.input (adapted to Lezer)

==>
SourceFile(
  Comment)

# cue/format/testdata/comments.txtar / comment_field.input (adapted to Lezer)
// Just one comment on a field.
foo: string
==>
SourceFile(
  Comment,
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          PrimaryExpr(
            OperandName(
              Identifier)))))))

# cue/format/testdata/comments.txtar / issue4404.input (adapted to Lezer)

  Comment,
  Comment)

# cue/format/testdata/comments.txtar / issue1006.input (adapted to Lezer)
// issue #1006: comments should not be aligned across the opening
// or closing token of a multi-line struct, list, or func call.

very_long_to_push_out_the_comment: { // comment
	a: string // comment

	b: string // comment
} | "very_long_to_push_out_the_comment" // comment

very_long_to_push_out_the_comment: [ // comment
	a, // comment

	b, // comment
] | "very_long_to_push_out_the_comment" // comment

very_long_to_push_out_the_comment: f( // comment
	a, // comment

	b, // comment
) | "very_long_to_push_out_the_comment" // comment

==>
SourceFile(
  Comment,
  Comment,
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          BinExpr(
            Expression(
              PrimaryExpr(
                Literal(
                  StructLit(
                    "{",
                    Comment,
                    Declaration(
                      Field(
                        Label(
                          LabelExpr(
                            LabelName(
                              Identifier))),
                        AliasExpr(
                          Expression(
                            PrimaryExpr(
                              OperandName(
                                Identifier)))))),
                    Comment,
                    Declaration(
                      Field(
                        Label(
                          LabelExpr(
                            LabelName(
                              Identifier))),
                        AliasExpr(
                          Expression(
                            PrimaryExpr(
                              OperandName(
                                Identifier)))))),
                    Comment,
                    "}")))),
            Expression(
              PrimaryExpr(
                Literal(
                  BasicLit(
                    StringLit(
                      SimpleStringLit)))))))))),
  Comment,
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          BinExpr(
            Expression(
              PrimaryExpr(
                Literal(
                  ListLit(
                    "[",
                    Comment,
                    ElementList(
                      Embedding(
                        AliasExpr(
                          Expression(
                            PrimaryExpr(
                              OperandName(
                                Identifier))))),
                      Comment,
                      Embedding(
                        AliasExpr(
                          Expression(
                            PrimaryExpr(
                              OperandName(
                                Identifier)))))),
                    Comment,
                    "]")))),
            Expression(
              PrimaryExpr(
                Literal(
                  BasicLit(
                    StringLit(
                      SimpleStringLit)))))))))),
  Comment,
  Declaration(
    Field(
      Label(
        LabelExpr(
          LabelName(
            Identifier))),
      AliasExpr(
        Expression(
          BinExpr(
            Expression(
              PrimaryExpr(
                PrimaryExpr(
                  OperandName(
                    Identifier)),
                Arguments(
                  "(",
                  Comment,
                  Argument(
                    Expression(
                      PrimaryExpr(
                        OperandName(
                          Identifier)))),
                  Comment,
                  Argument(
                    Expression(
                      PrimaryExpr(
                        OperandName(
                          Identifier)))),
                  Comment,
                  ")"))),
            Expression(
              PrimaryExpr(
                Literal(
                  BasicLit(
                    StringLit(
                      SimpleStringLit)))))))))),
  Comment)
